chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever eats a seed from a pomegranate, it sickens the Satan of whispering for forty days.

key_terms.شَيْطَانَ الْوَسْوَسَةِ: Satan of whispering (the source of evil inclinations)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of eating pomegranate seeds according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kulayni’s *al-Kafi*, this narration links the physical consumption of pomegranate to spiritual purification, specifically weakening the 'Satan of whispering' (*Shaytan al-Waswasa*) for forty days. This duration mirrors the lunar cycle of fasting and reflection, suggesting that regular intake aids in sustaining mindfulness (*muraqaba*) and curbing inner distractions. The hadith reflects the Shia tradition of viewing natural remedies as means to enhance spiritual resilience against evil inclinations.
